subject: Request: PO & spend cap for Midwest Tech Summit (booth + travel)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Midwest Tech Summit <events@midwesttech.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO & spend cap for Midwest Tech Summit (booth + travel)

Hi Marcus / Laura —

We're confirmed as a Gold sponsor for Midwest Tech Summit (Chicago, Sep 14-16). Vendor sent the attached quote. High-level ask: can Finance issue a PO and set a spend cap w/ advance approval for the items below so we can lock the booth and start travel approvals?

Breakdown (estimates attached in attendee_travel_estimates.csv):
- Booth package (space + basic build): $12,000 (vendor invoice attached: draft_invoice_MTS_booth.pdf)
- Lead retrieval & branding add-ons: $2,500
- Travel (5 people): $3,000 (air + per diem estimates)

Total requested cap: $17,500.

Notes/questions:
- Vendor requires a PO to hold the $12k booth price through Aug 1.
- We'll use individual reimbursements for travel (Expensify) unless Finance prefers a P-card for flights.
- Cost center: marketing ops — need code from you.

Attachments: MTS2026_vendor_quote.xlsx, draft_invoice_MTS_booth.pdf, attendee_travel_estimates.csv

Action requested: Marcus/Laura — please advise best path (PO vs P-card), provide cost-center/GL coding and confirm PO issuance timeline. We need PO before Aug 1.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PO & spend cap for Midwest Tech Summit (booth + travel)

Camila —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and attachments. A few clarifying items before I can approve a PO: 
1) Confirm vendor legal name & W9 (we need vendor legal entity on file).
2) Confirm whether the booth balance will be invoiced in one payment or in installments. PO will reference full amount but payment terms matter.
3) Travel: Finance prefers P-card for flights if tickets will be centrally booked. If attendees prefer booking themselves we can do reimbursements through Expensify, but note per diem caps apply.

If vendor legal is the one on the quote (Midwest Tech Events, LLC) and invoice is single payment, I can create a PO once Laura signs off on cost center and approver.

Also, please confirm whether any creative production (branded booth elements) should be capitalized vs. expensed — that affects GL. If in doubt tag to marketing ops expense GL; we can reclass later if needed.

Marking this as high priority to meet your Aug 1 ask.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PO & spend cap for Midwest Tech Summit (booth + travel)

Thanks, Marcus and Camila.

I reviewed the quote. Finance is comfortable issuing a PO for the full booth package + lead retrieval and branding add-ons (total $14,500) with the following conditions:
- PO spend cap set to $18,000 to allow for minor scope changes and travel reimbursements.
- Cost center: 4102-MarketingOps. GL default: 6100 (Marketing Events). If there are capitalizable assets, flag them in the PO request form and we will route for reclassification.
- Vendor info required before PO issuance: official vendor name, remit address, and W9. Please get vendor to provide these by end of day Thu 18 Jun.
- For travel: we prefer P-card for airline bookings for one centralized card. Reimbursements for incidental expenses still go through Expensify. Attendees must submit itemized receipts and per diem summary.

Camila — once you confirm vendor legal name and payment terms I will generate the PO number and send a copy. Marcus: I will be the approver on this one (Laura.Bennett@redwood.com).

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

- Confirmation whether the $12,000 booth amount is invoiced in full on first invoice or split into deposit + remainder (if split, include schedule)

- Camila Reyes (Lead)

- Rishi Malhotra

- Priya Natarajan

Best,
Camila

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: PO issued: MTS-2026-PO-2847 (spend cap $18,000)

Camila / team —

PO MTS-2026-PO-2847 has been created and issued to vendor (Midwest Tech Events, LLC) with a spend cap of $18,000. Details below:
- PO owner/approver: Laura Bennett (Director, Finance Ops)
- Cost center: 4102-MarketingOps
- GL: 6100 (Marketing Events)
- Payment terms: Net 30; vendor confirmed single invoice (deposit not required per their reply). Vendor W9 and remit address are on file.
- P-card: Use central travel P-card to purchase airline tickets. Please route receipts + expense reports through Expensify for reimbursements beyond flights.

Attachments: copy of PO (MTS-2026-PO-2847.pdf) sent to vendor and uploaded to Drive (see related link).

Next steps for Camila/Tessa: finalize attendee travel plan, book flights on P-card, and collect receipts in Expensify. For any scope increases that would push the total above $18,000, submit a PO amendment request ASAP.

—Marcus
Senior Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference
